name: Rajiv Aryal
headline: I build secure, reliable web systems and help mission-driven teams stay safe online.
about:
As a Computer Science and Information Technology graduate, I have built experience in software engineering, web systems, and digital infrastructure through work with international nonprofit organizations and technology companies. My work spans web development, authentication systems, secure digital infrastructure, research publishing, and user-centred web applications.

Over the years, I have contributed to global movements through technical consulting, digital infrastructure, and research communication. Working with researchers, international nonprofits, and advocacy organizations has strengthened my interest in interdisciplinary research, where software engineering can improve accessibility, knowledge dissemination, and evidence-based decision-making.
achievements: Second Runner-up and 'Best Idea Award' at HULT IOST 2019 (national idea pitching competition)
Founding President of Birendra Open Source Club
